unresolved: All nine .data/.sdata2 facts and four section-origin links remain unresolved pending compiled symbols, sections, relocations and object extent evidence. Source coll_box and scalar literals are not proof of section identity.
No script/table data establishes exact command-variable timing, command 0's alleged ending-phase meaning, or the source of command 3 initialization. Local code establishes gates and writes only.

The local unk field is initialized from signed unk0+1 and not read in this TU. Timer semantics and out-of-TU consumers are not established. INT_MAX addition behavior needs compiled evidence before asserting wraparound.
Effect ID 0x47C's visual identity, all failure behavior of efSync_Spawn, x2219_b0's complete semantics, and full effect ownership/destruction lifetime remain unproved.
Collision-query internals, all query side effects, exact exceptional atan2f behavior for degenerate/nonfinite normals, and ft_8008A2BC's exact destination remain unproved.
Finite/nonnegative attribute-domain constraints are not supplied. Several baseline physics facts therefore remain unresolved rather than being retained as unconditional nonnegative/decay guarantees.

Rendered aliases are not independent proof. ftAnim_Advance, ground-acceleration and collision-query proposed names were not validated as exact complete meanings; airborne/grounded/fall-special aliases are only partial summaries of canonical helper behavior.

No compiled ABI evidence establishes that the eleven parameter entity locators labeled #r3 correspond to recovered register locations; source signatures are known, but no parameter writes are proposed.

The exact runtime guards surrounding the shared motion-change reset block and all external damage/death dispatch paths are not exhaustively characterized. The proven block is sufficient to reject guaranteed whole-move persistence of updateRot, not to claim a universal event-order model.
